Unpopular opinion: your morning routine is not the reason you are winning.

I used to wake up at 5am.

Cold shower. Journal. Meditate.

I thought that made me disciplined.

It didn't.

It made me tired — and honestly a little smug.

Then I ran the numbers on my best quarter.

I slept until 7 every single day.

The lesson?

Discipline is not a schedule.

It is choosing the one thing that matters and doing it badly until it works.

Agree? 🚀

#discipline #leadership #growth
